fieldNotes.site: Confirmed at 3045 New Tampa Hwy, Lakeland FL - Publix Manufacturing Central Warehouse (MCW) / Fresh Foods, Deli, Dairy and Produce complex. USDA FSIS lists it as Publix Supermarkets Deli Plant (large meat/poultry processing). A multi-building manufacturing-plus-distribution campus, distinct from the County Line HV/LV DC (idx 1) to the south. Supplied coords landed on the campus core and were kept.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. Satellite z20 at the central N-S access drive (28.0395,-82.0070) shows a controlled checkpoint: a small guard booth in the drive median with a long white sliding/swing barrier across the lanes. Street View on the internal access road shows a green 'GATE 5' sign and chain-link perimeter fencing on both sides of every approach - a fully fenced, numbered-gate campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE. Small dark booth (~1-2 car footprint) sits in the median of the checkpoint drive beside the barrier (z20 gate1 crop). Numbered gates ('GATE 5' sign) on a fenced campus indicate staffed/controlled entry.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Multiple numbered gates ('GATE 5' observed); estimated 3 controlled truck/employee gates around the perimeter. Flagged uncertain - only the central checkpoint was directly resolved.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+. Several large warehouses each with long dock banks. East warehouse south/west face shows 20+ doors with trailers backed in; additional dock faces on the central buildings and processing plant. Total ~130 estimated across the campus - flagged uncertain (rooftops obscure exact counts at z20).
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+. Dedicated NW trailer drop yard holds 100+ trailers in dense rows; a second large drop yard sits in the south-central spine. Easily 50+ dropped trailers.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - dedicated trailer-storage lots separate from active dock staging, full of parked trailers (NW yard z19).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE - dock banks on multiple different building faces across the campus (multi-building manufacturing + DC).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - campus of many large buildings (manufacturing plants, warehouses, processing with refrigeration silos/tanks).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - large paved internal yards and roadways behind the gate provide deep staging before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE - internal access drive from Gate 5 to the dock zones is long with room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE - wide gate aprons and multiple controlled gates give physical room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: FALSE - gate checkpoint is set well inside the property off New Tampa Hwy with extensive internal stacking room; a queue would not spill onto the public road.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound at the resolved checkpoint; not precisely countable from imagery - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: FALSE - no truck scale/weigh pad resolved in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE - no rail spur runs into the property; surrounded by golf course, retention ponds and roads.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - within the Lakeland metro, surrounded by mobile-home parks, commercial development and a golf community.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~113 acres for the operational footprint inside the fence line (excludes adjacent golf course/ponds). Derived from the perimeter polygon.
fieldNotes.streetView: Only one pano covers the property (LG3KSHrUjuj2o7LcGTFJiw, 2011-04) on the internal Gate-5 access road; both perimeter and truckGate streetViewMeta use it. heading 348 frames the fenced approach toward the gate - the arrival view a driver sees.
